statement: Runtime placement and CREATE consume one canonical interpretation of an authoritative service definition. Active valid Binding definitions retain producer-owned replica_count zero while receiving the system placement target; malformed or unavailable definitions cannot become scale-down or CREATE permission. One authoritative keyed read routes and executes an unrouted CREATE, while retained-origin custody keeps precedence.

constraints.statement: Apply evidence/design-review.md. Existing runtime-service-policy owns the shared decision and consumes the full existing Binding lineage/source-kind contract. Active valid Binding stored count zero keeps the system target; non-Binding rows use only canonical non-negative safe-integer replica_count and active status. Preserve valid scale zero separately from inactive, invalid or unavailable target; no default target, camelCase count, coercion or invalid-to-zero permission. All current scheduler, discovery, admin and remote-cache consumers consume that decision. Retain compiled Binding row equality and member eligibility.

Only the explicit controlPlaneSystemTableGateway.readAuthoritativeRows port with existing OWNER_RPC_REQUIRED/REQUIRED authority supplies CREATE definitions. Validate the successful own-data dense keyed population before cache reconciliation: zero or one exact service_id row. Missing/throwing/failed/malformed authority is typed UNAVAILABLE; successful empty alone is ABSENT. Remove CREATE cache/CDC/method/Array fallbacks, bare-row resolver and repeated generic read. Carry the same named resolution from classification through generic execution; reconcile through the existing cache owner only.

Existing journal-first retained origin routing, current execution/generation, wake, shutdown and retirement fences remain. UNAVAILABLE emits its canonical retryable outcome through the existing settlement owner; confirmed absence/ineligibility remains permanent. Unknown resolution is UNAVAILABLE, never absence. No new timer, supervisor or state store. Generic REMOVE authority remains separately recorded, not represented as fixed.

Actual Binding/catalog/definition producer and actual handler/route/outcome composition with explicit controlled boundaries; old-source negative and invalid/non-Binding-zero/inactive/partial-lineage controls; stale positive cache versus missing, throwing, failed, bare-array, duplicate, sparse, wrong-id and null-row authority; one-read row-class change; finite existing-owner retry; retained-origin precedence and duplicate/current-generation/shutdown controls. Preserve the runtime lane-budget witness bound, churn negatives and assertions, correcting only its canonical gateway construction. Register the interaction and keep public Cell, full caller-cone and physical formation evidence separate.
